frontierSource.title: Puppeteer v25.16.0 CDP ElementHandle.uploadFile (answering a file chooser)
frontierSource.quote: DOM.setFileInputFiles does not actually update the files in that case, so the solution is to eval the element value to a new FileList directly.
frontierSource.teaches: An independent CDP client corroborates the pick-empty no-op from the client side and shows the in-page fallback dispatching untrusted input/change - the same signature the round-77 degenerate cases encode. Caveat: this version pins Chrome 156.0.8078.47, not the lane's Chromium 155.0.8059.84, so it documents client-side usage, not 155 server behaviour.
